Pie menus and special navigation, selection, and transformation controls that let you use Blender with ONLY one hand and a mouse or tablet! You'll probably want an on-screen keyboard to help you type vertex group names, enter numbers, etc., but besides that, trust me, it's epic.

Inspired by [Flow Navigation](https://superhivemarket.com/products/flow-navigation). I LOVE that addon (I recommend at least trying out the free Lite version, it will change your life). However, I had to edit it a bit to get it exactly how I wanted, plus it lagged my viewport and I found its UI annoying. I wanted my own simpler alterative.
